  "coverage_explanation": "Exercises live HHMM display, elapsed-time advancement, all three SET commands, edited reminder activation, 500 ms LED cadence, repeated confirmation, two independent 30-second missed-dose reports, newline and idle framing, invalid minute rejection, and valid HHMM endpoints. Timeout does not require silence or LED shutdown. Report windows include serial processing, activation, and reporting latency allowances. Partial: the supported observation schema cannot establish phase-independent audible activity or continuous buzzer silence; only post-confirmation silence samples are checked. Browsing is stimulated but its unspecified display encoding prevents independent status assertions. Missed-counter initialization, incrementing, and retention have no specified observable representation and are not asserted. Natural midnight rollover, daily repetition, and default alarm times are not independently tested. The reference preserves outstanding reminders and deadlines across midnight.",
  "assumptions": [
    "Uses disclosed electrical defaults: D13 LED is active HIGH; D2, D3, and D4 buttons connect to GND and use INPUT_PULLUP.",
    "Uses the authoritative textual TIME and SET1..SET3 commands at 9600 baud with newline or 20 ms idle termination; the conflicting numeric command-code inventories are not used as an alternative wire protocol.",
    "The supplied 250 ms response allowance is included separately for command processing, reminder activation, and missed-report delivery where applicable.",
    "The phase and tone frequency of the intermittent buzzer are unspecified. The reference chooses 2000 Hz with alternating 500 ms audible and silent phases; activation checks do not impose that frequency or phase.",
    "Reminder-status display encoding, browse wrap behavior, and missed-counter presentation are unspecified. The reference chooses numeric status pages without requiring candidates to use that encoding.",
    "The reference retains an unconfirmed alarm after its missed-dose report until confirmation. Tests also permit implementations that silence or close it at timeout.",
    "No reset or power-cycle retention requirement is inferred for the missed counter."

  "reference_cpp": "#include <Arduino.h>\n#include <TM1637Display.h>\n#include <string.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\n#include <ctype.h>\n\nTM1637Display display(7, 5);\nstruct Reminder {\n  int minute;\n  long firedDay;\n  bool active;\n  bool reported;\n  uint8_t status;\n  unsigned long started;\n};\nReminder reminders[3] = {\n  {420, -1, false, false, 0, 0},\n  {720, -1, false, false, 0, 0},\n  {1080, -1, false, false, 0, 0}\n};\nunsigned long missedCount = 0;\nunsigned long previousMillis = 0;\nunsigned long dayMillis = 0;\nlong dayNumber = 0;\nint page = -1;\nbool soundOn = false;\nchar frame[48];\nuint8_t frameLength = 0;\nbool overflowed = false;\nunsigned long lastByte = 0;\nconst uint8_t buttonPins[3] = {2, 3, 4};\nbool rawButtons[3] = {HIGH, HIGH, HIGH};\nbool stableButtons[3] = {HIGH, HIGH, HIGH};\nunsigned long changedAt[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n\nvoid rollDay() {\n  ++dayNumber;\n  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {\n    if (!reminders[i].active) {\n      reminders[i].status = 0;\n      reminders[i].reported = false;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nvoid updateClock(unsigned long now) {\n  unsigned long delta = now - previousMillis;\n  previousMillis = now;\n  dayMillis += delta;\n  while (dayMillis >= 86400000UL) {\n    dayMillis -= 86400000UL;\n    rollDay();\n  }\n}\n\nvoid processFrame() {\n  frame[frameLength] = '\\0';\n  char *p = frame;\n  while (isspace((unsigned char)*p)) ++p;\n  char *command = p;\n  while (*p && !isspace((unsigned char)*p)) ++p;\n  if (!*p) return;\n  *p++ = '\\0';\n  while (isspace((unsigned char)*p)) ++p;\n  char *end = 0;\n  long value = strtol(p, &end, 10);\n  if (end == p) return;\n  while (isspace((unsigned char)*end)) ++end;\n  if (*end || value < 0 || value > 2359 || value % 100 >= 60) return;\n  int minute = int(value / 100) * 60 + int(value % 100);\n  if (strcmp(command, \"TIME\") == 0) {\n    dayMillis = (unsigned long)minute * 60000UL;\n    return;\n  }\n  int index = -1;\n  if (strcmp(command, \"SET1\") == 0) index = 0;\n  if (strcmp(command, \"SET2\") == 0) index = 1;\n  if (strcmp(command, \"SET3\") == 0) index = 2;\n  if (index >= 0 && reminders[index].minute != minute) {\n    reminders[index].minute = minute;\n    if (!reminders[index].active) {\n      reminders[index].firedDay = -1;\n      reminders[index].status = 0;\n      reminders[index].reported = false;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nvoid finishFrame() {\n  if (!overflowed && frameLength) processFrame();\n  frameLength = 0;\n  overflowed = false;\n}\n\nvoid readSerial(unsigned long now) {\n  while (Serial.available()) {\n    char c = (char)Serial.read();\n    lastByte = now;\n    if (c == '\\n' || c == '\\r') finishFrame();\n    else if (frameLength < sizeof(frame) - 1) frame[frameLength++] = c;\n    else overflowed = true;\n  }\n  if ((frameLength || overflowed) && now - lastByte >= 20) finishFrame();\n}\n\nvoid buttonPressed(int index) {\n  if (index == 0) {\n    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {\n      if (reminders[i].active) {\n        reminders[i].active = false;\n        if (!reminders[i].reported) reminders[i].status = 2;\n      }\n    }\n  } else if (index == 1) {\n    page = (page == -1) ? 2 : page - 1;\n  } else {\n    page = (page == 2) ? -1 : page + 1;\n  }\n}\n\nvoid readButtons(unsigned long now) {\n  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {\n    bool value = digitalRead(buttonPins[i]);\n    if (value != rawButtons[i]) {\n      rawButtons[i] = value;\n      changedAt[i] = now;\n    }\n    if (value != stableButtons[i] && now - changedAt[i] >= 25) {\n      stableButtons[i] = value;\n      if (value == LOW) buttonPressed(i);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nvoid updateReminders(unsigned long now) {\n  int currentMinute = dayMillis / 60000UL;\n  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {\n    Reminder &r = reminders[i];\n    if (!r.active && r.firedDay != dayNumber && currentMinute == r.minute) {\n      r.firedDay = dayNumber;\n      r.active = true;\n      r.reported = false;\n      r.status = 1;\n      r.started = now;\n    }\n    if (r.active && !r.reported && now - r.started >= 30000UL) {\n      r.reported = true;\n      r.status = 3;\n      ++missedCount;\n      Serial.print(\"missed dose \");\n      Serial.print(i + 1);\n      Serial.print(\" total \");\n      Serial.println(missedCount);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nvoid updateOutputs(unsigned long now) {\n  bool on = false;\n  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {\n    if (reminders[i].active && ((now - reminders[i].started) / 500UL) % 2 == 0) on = true;\n  }\n  digitalWrite(13, on ? HIGH : LOW);\n  if (on != soundOn) {\n    soundOn = on;\n    if (on) tone(6, 2000);\n    else noTone(6);\n  }\n  if (page < 0) {\n    int minute = dayMillis / 60000UL;\n    display.showNumberDecEx((minute / 60) * 100 + minute % 60, 0x40, true);\n  } else {\n    display.showNumberDec((page + 1) * 100 + reminders[page].status, true);\n  }\n}\n\nvoid setup() {\n  Serial.begin(9600);\n  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) pinMode(buttonPins[i], INPUT_PULLUP);\n  pinMode(13, OUTPUT);\n  pinMode(6, OUTPUT);\n  digitalWrite(13, LOW);\n  noTone(6);\n  display.setBrightness(7);\n  display.showNumberDecEx(0, 0x40, true);\n  previousMillis = millis();\n}\n\nvoid loop() {\n  unsigned long now = millis();\n  updateClock(now);\n  readSerial(now);\n  updateReminders(now);\n  readButtons(now);\n  updateOutputs(now);\n}\n"
}

independent_failure.error: Independent requirement audit rejected this test/reference: {"approved": false, "coverage": "partial", "issues": ["The reference can suppress subsequent daily reminders indefinitely. updateReminders() starts a daily occurrence only when !r.active, while rollDay() deliberately preserves an outstanding active reminder. If an alarm remains unconfirmed through its next scheduled day, r.active and r.reported remain true: no new occurrence starts, no new 30-second deadline is established, and no additional missed-dose warning or counter increment occurs. Track daily occurrences independently of outstanding acknowledgment state, or otherwise ensure each day's scheduled reminder starts and receives its own timeout accounting. Add an unconfirmed-across-midnight daily-repetition test."], "coverage_gaps": ["No assertion establishes that D6 actually sounds during an alarm or follows the required intermittent 500 ms cadence. Silence is checked only at selected post-confirmation times.", "D3/D4 are stimulated, but previous/next reminder browsing and the correctness of today's displayed reminder statuses are not verified.", "Missed-counter initialization, incrementing, and retention are not independently verified; counting warning messages does not establish counter state.", "Default 07:00, 12:00, and 18:00 alarms, natural midnight rollover, daily repetition, and outstanding reminders spanning midnight are not exercised.", "Invalid-minute rejection is tested for TIME only, not for SET1 through SET3."], "reason": "The tested pin assignments, electrical polarity, HHMM interpretation, textual framing, confirmation behavior, and timeout windows are consistent with the supplied conditions. The suite appropriately avoids requiring an unspecified browse encoding, buzzer frequency, or shutdown behavior after timeout, and honestly declares partial coverage. Nevertheless, the reference fails the explicit daily-alarm behavior when an earlier occurrence remains unconfirmed, so the proposal cannot be approved as supplied."}
